newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia protests over Sudan envoy's statement.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia protests over Sudan envoy's statement.

text.p: Ethiopia protested to Sudan on Thursday about an alleged call by a Sudanese diplomat in Mogadishu for holy war against Ethiopia.

The foreign ministry called on Khartoum to "take urgent action to disassociate itself from the provocative statement made by its diplomat in Mogadishu," said the letter, printed by state-run Ethiopian News Agency.
"The Ethiopian Government views the statement of Sudan's diplomat in Mogadishu as a hostile act directed against the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the country," the letter added.
Ethiopia said Sudanese diplomats were now restricted to the capital.

Sudanese Charge d' Affaires in Mogadishu Ali Hassan Ali told supporters of al-Itihad al-Islam on December 29 to fight a jihad against Ethiopian efforts to repulse an invasion by the Moslem fundamentalist group, the letter alleged.
